UNIVERSITY AND SCHOOLS 


May 2th, 1963 


SIR GEORGE WILLIAMS SCHOOL OF ART 


A ANNUAL EXHIBITION OF STUDRNTS' WORK 


Opening Monday, May 27th, in Birks Hall at Sir George 


Williams University is an exhibition of art, sketching 
and sculpture done by students of the Sir George 
Williams School of Art. . .The school, which registers 


30 day students in a three year diploma course and 
186 evening students, gives instruction in formal 
classical art forms, modern painting and sketching, 
and commercial advertising art. The Director is 

Mr. Leslie Smith. 


B PRESENTATION OF DIPLOMAS AND AWARDS 


On Wednesday, May 29th, at 8:00 p.m. in Birks Hall, 
SGWU, diplomas and awards will be presented to a 
dozen students graduating from the school. 


Radio & Newspaper 


Mr. Smith would very much aporeciate 
any advance oublic notice you can 
arrange for the students! exhibition. 
--with thanks, 


G. H. W.
